wordmark.purpose: The brand: 3rem heading in the Sorzs header (about 3.75rem on screen), 1.5rem on the entry screen, plus the S of the add button and Sorz in the add dialog title. Script face only.

title.purpose: Backoffice section title and each search result title.

motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and focus changes on buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main confirm action such as Add or Log in.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #205ea6; color: #fffcf0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(32 94 166 / .9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(32 94 166 / .5); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only header and row action, 32px; transparent with the icon in Library Blue, Paper Hover on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Backoffice"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #205ea6; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { background: #e6e4d9; color: #282726; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(32 94 166 / .5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid #cecdc3; border-radius: 6px; background: #fffcf0; color: #100f0f; font-size: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6f6e69; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #205ea6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(32 94 166 / .5); }

components.name: Source Menu Item
components.description: A trusted source in the side bar: favicon in a 24px tile and name, 40px tall.
components.css: .ds-side { width: 256px; padding: 8px; background: #f2f0e5; border-right: 1px solid #cecdc3; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-side-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 40px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: #100f0f; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-side-item:hover { background: #e6e4d9; color: #282726; } .ds-side-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid #cecdc3; border-radius: 4px; background: #fffcf0; }

components.name: Search Result
components.description: A result link: source in faded ink, blue title, description. Paper Hover fill on hover. No card.
components.html: example.comSearch it on GoogleGoogle search for «term» limited to example.com
components.css: .ds-result { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: #100f0f; text-decoration: none; } .ds-result:hover { background: #e6e4d9; } .ds-result:hover .ds-result-title { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-result-source { color: #6f6e69; font-size: 14px; } .ds-result-desc { color: #6f6e69; font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; } .ds-result-title { color: #205ea6; font-size: 17px; line-height: 24px; }

components.name: Health Mark
components.description: Status icon beside the brand: checking, up, down.
components.html: <svg class="ds-health" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" role="status" aria-label="Service is up"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg>

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Floating surface for adding a source or a user.
components.html:
Add source

Paste the address of a site you trust.
components.css: .ds-dialog { max-width: 512px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #cecdc3; border-radius: 8px; background: #fffcf0; color: #100f0f; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / .1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); } .ds-dialog-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dialog-body { margin: 0; color: #6f6e69; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Side Label Field
components.description: Add-source form field: label in a 3.5rem column on the left, control beside it.
components.css: .ds-side-field { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.5rem 1fr; align-items: center; column-gap: 12px; } .ds-side-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #100f0f; } .ds-side-input { height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid #cecdc3; border-radius: 6px; background: #fffcf0; color: #100f0f; font-size: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-side-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #205ea6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(32 94 166 / .5); }

components.name: Empty Source List
components.description: Side bar with no sources: library icon over faded text.
components.html: You have no sources yet
components.css: .ds-empty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 24px 8px; text-align: center; color: #6f6e69; } .ds-empty p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview:
Sorzs looks like a small reading room kept by one person: warm paper, dark ink, a handwritten nameplate over the door, and shelves of sites someone chose. Nothing performs. The interface is calm, bookish and understated, and it gets out of the way of the links, which are the whole point.

Density is moderate and chrome is thin. A single header with a hairline rule, a tonal shelf (the side bar) for the user's sources, and an open main area for results. One blue accent does all the pointing; green and red appear only as status. The only flourish is the script wordmark.

The look follows the operating system's light or dark preference, with no toggle. Light is paper and ink; dark is the same room at night.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Flexoki paper and ink, never pure white or pure black.
One blue accent; green and red are status only.
Flat: borders and tonal surfaces carry depth, shadows are rare.
One handwritten element, the wordmark; everything else is system sans.
Icon-first controls with tooltips and accessible names.

rules.name: The One Pointer Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only accent. It marks what can be acted on and where focus is. Green and red never decorate.

rules.name: The No Pure Rule
rules.body: No #fff or #000. Every neutral is tinted warm, in both themes.

rules.name: The Single Script Rule
rules.body: The script face appears only as the brand, never as plain text. Section headings, button labels and results use the sans.

rules.name: The Flat Shelf Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest have no shadow. A shadow means the surface floats above the page (dialog, popover, tooltip).

dos: Do fill every color from the shadcn variables so light and dark swap together.
Do make header and row actions icon-only with a tooltip and an accessible name.
Do keep results as plain text blocks on the page; the link is the interface.
Do give any hard-coded size a token in @theme (as --text-wordmark) rather than an arbitrary class.
donts: Don't use pure white or pure black; stay in the tinted Flexoki neutrals.
Don't add a second accent color or use green or red for decoration.
Don't use the script face outside the brand.
Don't add shadows to surfaces at rest, and don't wrap results in cards.
Don't add a theme toggle; the theme follows the operating system.
Don't give the backoffice its own tokens or components; it differs from Sorzs only in what it shows.
Don't make more than one button in a row solid blue.
